description: RAG system design, implementation, and optimization - chunking strategies, embedding models (Voyage 4 family, OpenAI v3, Cohere embed-v4, Gemini, BGE-M3, NV-Embed-v2, Nomic MoE, Jina v3), vector databases (Qdrant 1.13-1.16), hybrid search, modern rerankers (Voyage rerank-2.5, Cohere Rerank 3.5, Jina Reranker v3, mxbai-rerank-v2), advanced patterns (HippoRAG, LightRAG, LongRAG, Agentic RAG, CRAG, Self-RAG, GraphRAG), evaluation (RAGAS/DeepEval/TruLens), and production deployment
